findings.summary: Commit b7a8685 changes two existing tests' expected values (text-fault-proof.test.ts:33 EVERY_SPEC_BEFORE 12139 -> 12139 + 7; text-fewer-tests.test.ts:33 everySpec 12142 + 18 -> + 18 + 7) while the spec's ## Test changes says "none"; test-changes.mjs lists both as undeclared. Not blocking: acceptance spec-19-4 permits this growth, and without the +7 both sibling tests fail (12164 - 12139 = 25 > 20; 12164 > 12160). The new value equals the measured growth exactly and each test still caps its own spec's growth. Decompose should declare such re-baselines as class 1 next time.
